kjv: and blesseth the covetous, [whom] the LORD abhorreth
mine: and the one greedy for gain curses and renounces Yahweh
note: uvotsea' berekh ni'ets yhwh: botsea' is most naturally the subject ("the greedy man"), and berekh "bless" is the scribal euphemism for "curse" (as in Job 1:5) paired with ni'ets "spurns"; the KJV makes the wicked bless the greedy and God abhor them.

mine: His ways prosper at all times
note: yahilu derakhaw: hyl/hwl here means "be firm, prosper" (cf. Job 20:21), not "be grievous".
